title: Turbo Kart Battle
description: High-velocity top-down kart racing combat! Drift tight neon chicanes, grab combat power-ups like homing rockets and speed boosts, and blast your way to the podium.
instructions: Steer your turbo kart through 3 intense laps on the neon circuit.
Drive over mystery weapon crates to pick up Rockets, Boosts, Shields, and Mines.
Fire rockets at leaders ahead of you and drop mines to block chasers.
Finish in 1st place to claim the Grand Prix Championship!
controls: Arrow Keys / WASD / Touch Buttons: Steer, Accelerate & Reverse
Space / Power-up Button: Deploy equipped weapon
